name: outside the door
source:
Outside the door – a visual novel with elements of mysticism and a gripping storyline taking place within an office. On behalf of a temp who turned out to be at this office for some odd reason you have to listen to the stories of a few visitors and having puzzled out the details of their destinies deliver your verdict before their cases will be passed on. To make things even worse, you’ve got no memories of your past and the only assistant in this weird place is a featureless voice on the radio. Should you do your job in good faith or whether you can trust anyone here is up to you but someone has to be responsible for decisions made.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680680/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Outside the Door》是一部帶有神秘色彩的視覺小說，故事發生在一間辦公室裡。你是個因某種奇怪緣由來到這裡的臨時工，必須聽幾位訪客講述經歷，弄清他們命運中的細節，並在案件移交前給出裁斷。更糟的是，你對自己的過去一無所知，唯一的幫手是收音機裡一道毫無特徵的聲音。要不要誠心辦好差事，這裡有沒有人值得信任，都得由你判斷。可無論怎麼決定，總要有人為決定負責。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680680/]Steam[/url]］
